comments.body:
@Jasper-Bekkers 

> Looks like some mistakes with the host/device toggle made their way in, or I'm mis-understanding what the `is_host` boolean should be doing.

Hi Jasper, the `is_host` boolean here is used to select the same `AllocationSizes` policy as the existing allocation path. All three checks are identical to those already present in `MemoryType::allocate()`, but they are problematic and you have found real issues.

The intention is to keep allocation and deallocation consistent, rather than introduce or change the host/device classification. If the existing classification needs correcting, I am happy to do that in another PR or would you like me to expand the scope of this PR and do that work here too? (I am up for it.)
